name: TensorForge
one_liner: Multi-tenant GPU cluster scheduling and prefix-cached LLM serving platform.

hard_problems.title: Paged KV-cache fragmentation under variable prompt lengths
hard_problems.description: High-concurrency serving clusters with mixed 2k and 64k context requests hit HBM exhaustion and prefix-tree thrashing before compute utilization reaches 60%.

hard_problems.title: Zero-stall asynchronous checkpointing on spot GPU clusters
hard_problems.description: Preemptible multi-node training jobs lose 18% of cluster hours waiting on synchronous all-reduce barriers and host-to-object-store weight flushes.

hard_problems.title: Continuous batching SLO isolation across heterogeneous LoRA adapters
hard_problems.description: Co-locating bursty long-generation adapters with latency-sensitive interactive tenants starves time-to-first-token p99 budgets under shared scheduler queues.
